definitions.explanation: A state of having no motivation, energy, or willpower. Describes a person who lacks drive or enthusiasm, or a condition where someone cannot muster the will to act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{無気力|むきりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦したくない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I've been feeling listless lately and don't want to do anything.

examples.japanese: {無気力|むきりょく}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Work won't get done with that apathetic attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{無気力|むきりょく}な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}せなかった→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧。
examples.english: After the long break, I couldn't easily shake off the state of lethargy.

notes:
USAGE: {無気力|むきりょく} can be used as a noun (a state of apathy) or as a na-adjective ({無気力|むきりょく}な). It often describes a temporary psychological state but can also characterize someone's general personality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無気力|むきりょく}な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a state of apathy
- {無気力|むきりょく}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: listless attitude
- {無気力|むきりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into apathy
- {無気力|むきりょく}{感|かん}: feeling of lethargy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無気力|むきりょく}: lacking energy or motivation (general apathy)
- ⟦{倦怠|けんたい}→倦怠：06004_kentai⟧: weariness, languor (physical and mental fatigue)
- ⟦{脱力|だつりょく}→脱力：10659_datsuryoku⟧: losing strength, going limp (physical or emotional deflation)
